tasks.title: Interpret a Retention Experiment
tasks.context: A retention experiment shows a positive estimate but a wide confidence interval.
tasks.goal: Communicate uncertainty without overstating the result.
tasks.prompt: What should you tell the product team?
tasks.expectedAnswer: The estimate is encouraging but uncertain; report the interval and collect more evidence before treating the lift as established
hints: Use the point estimate and interval together.
A wide interval means substantial uncertainty.
Do not convert uncertainty into certainty.
tasks.explanation: Decision-quality experiment reporting combines effect size with uncertainty.
options: The estimate is encouraging but uncertain; report the interval and collect more evidence before treating the lift as established
The positive estimate guarantees a lift
A wide interval proves there is no effect
